allow: Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes obsserv 'echo === ARGOCD APPS === && kubectl -n argocd get applications && echo === DEV PODS === && kubectl -n observatory-dev get pods && echo === RELEASE PODS === && kubectl -n observatory-release get pods')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes obsserv 'kubectl -n argocd annotate application observatory-dev argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard --overwrite && kubectl -n argocd annotate application observatory-release argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard --overwrite')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes obsserv 'echo === APPS === && kubectl -n argocd get applications && echo === DEV PODS === && kubectl -n observatory-dev get pods && echo === REL PODS === && kubectl -n observatory-release get pods')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes obsserv 'kubectl -n argocd get application observatory-dev -o jsonpath="{.status.conditions}" 2>/dev/null; echo; kubectl -n argocd get application observatory-dev -o jsonpath="{.status.operationState.message}"; echo; kubectl -n observatory-dev get rs')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes obsserv 'kubectl -n observatory-release get pods && echo --- && kubectl -n observatory-release describe pod -l app=api 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Image:|Failed|Pulling|Ready " | head -10')

Bash(ssh -o BatchMode=yes obsserv 'kubectl -n argocd get application observatory-release -o jsonpath="{.status.operationState.message}"; echo; kubectl -n argocd get application observatory-release -o jsonpath="{.status.resources[?\(@.kind==\\"Deployment\\"\)].health.message}"')
